from pathlib import Path
import json,time,subprocess
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');state=s/'conditional-runner-finish-state.json'
def phase(name,**kw):
 state.write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
def run(script,logname,gpu=False):
 args=['bash','-lc',f'source {s}/write-protection-gpu.env\npython3 {s}/{script}']if gpu else['python3',str(s/script)]
 with(s/logname).open('w')as log:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
def commit(message):
 subprocess.run(['git','add','src/tests/benchmark/CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_LIMITS_RESULTS.md','src/tests/benchmark/CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_LIMITS_EVIDENCE.json'],cwd=r,check=True)
 subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m',message],cwd=r,check=True)
try:
 phase('waiting_for_tail_prefix_analysis')
 while not(s/'tail-prefix-analysis-complete.json').exists():time.sleep(5)
 assert json.loads((s/'tail-prefix-module-state.json').read_text())['phase']=='modules_complete'
 assert json.loads((s/'tail-prefix-analysis-complete.json').read_text())['allow_runner_revisit']
 phase('correctness')
 run('conditional_runner_acceptance.py','conditional-runner-acceptance.log')
 run('record_conditional_runner_acceptance.py','conditional-runner-acceptance-record.log')
 commit('Verify conditional-leaf runner caps against native faults and full replay')
 phase('serial_timing')
 run('guarded_conditional_runner_timings.py','conditional-runner-timing-driver.log')
 run('record_conditional_runner_timings.py','conditional-runner-timing-record.log')
 commit('Retain reordered conditional-leaf runner cap timings')
 phase('diagnostic_correctness_and_census')
 run('run_conditional_runner_census.py','conditional-runner-census-driver.log',gpu=True)
 phase('census_complete_pending_record')
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise

 for scene,frames,pcm in [('standard',1600,4656051),('long',360,2832756)]:
  path=s/f'conditional-runner-diagnostic-{cap}-{scene}';v=json.loads(path.with_name(path.name+'-compare.json').read_text());q=json.loads((path/'report.json').read_text());assert v['match']and v['frames']==frames and v['audio']['sample_frames']==pcm
  assert q['exit_census'] and q['leaf_features']==0 and q['execution_limits']==[512,16,8,cap] and q['verify_aot']==1024;e['diagnostics'][f'replay-{cap}-{scene}']=dict(comparison=v,report=q)
text='\n## Conditional-only runner-limit census\n\nThe two changed bounds separately pass another 81,280 explicitly selected instrumented native fault comparisons and exact checked standard/longer image/audio replays. Cap 512 reuses the same frozen binary and policy from the preceding tail-prefix control census; it is not a fresh run. Diagnostic elapsed time is excluded from throughput acceptance.\n'
for scene in ['long','standard']:
 data={}
 for cap in [64,512,0]:
  path=s/(f'tail-prefix-census-{scene}-control16'if cap==512 else f'conditional-runner-census-{scene}-'+('cap64'if cap==64 else'uncapped'))
  q=json.loads((path/'report.json').read_text());g=json.loads((path/'guest-profile.json').read_text());b=g['boundaries']
  assert q['exit_census'] and q['leaf_features']==0 and q['predicated_leaves']==1 and q['execution_limits']==[512,16,8,cap] and q['ir_mode']==7
  assert q['wasm_sha256']==e['archive']['files']['eka2l1.wasm'] and q['tlb_hash']==1 and q['code_compare']==2 and q['code_lookup']==0 and q['eager_regions']==0 and q['shared_audio']
  expected=(6445351805,9476989025,380)if scene=='long'else(8980877653,11957513019,381)
  assert tuple(q['measurement'][k]for k in ['first_instructions','last_instructions','presentations'])==expected
  assert sum(b['region_exits'].values())==g['compiled_blocks']==b['calls']
  assert sum(b['callee_restrictions'].values())==b['call_constraints'].get('callee_unsupported',0)
  assert sum(b['entry_proof_fallback_causes'].values())==b['entry_proof_fallbacks']<=b['entry_proof_attempts']<=b['calls']
  assert sum(b['code_guard_outcomes'].values())==sum(b['region_exits'].get(k,0)for k in ['code_write_guard','helper_and_code_write'])
  if cap==0:assert not b['runner_returns'].get('region_cap',0)
  data[cap]=b;e['diagnostics'][f'{scene}-cap{cap}']=dict(path=str(path),reused=cap==512,report=q,profile=g)
 text+='\n### '+scene+'\n\n| Counter | 64 regions | 512 regions | Uncapped |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
 selectors=[('Runner invocations',lambda b:sum(b['runner_returns'].values())),('Cap returns',lambda b:b['runner_returns'].get('region_cap',0)),('Budget returns',lambda b:b['runner_returns'].get('budget',0)),('Zero-progress returns',lambda b:b['runner_returns'].get('zero_progress',0)),('Missing successor returns',lambda b:b['runner_returns'].get('successor_unavailable',0)),('Compiled invocations',lambda b:b['calls']),('Direct-call exits',lambda b:b['region_exits'].get('call',0)),('Site-limit exits',lambda b:b['call_constraints'].get('inline_site_limit',0)),('Leaf-length limit exits',lambda b:b['call_constraints'].get('leaf_instruction_limit',0)),('Dependency spans requested',lambda b:b['validated_snapshot_requests']['dependency_spans']),('Dependency bytes requested',lambda b:b['validated_snapshot_requests']['dependency_bytes']),('Primary bytes requested',lambda b:b['validated_snapshot_requests']['primary_bytes']),('Entry-proof attempts',lambda b:b['entry_proof_attempts']),('Private entry-proof fallbacks',lambda b:b['entry_proof_fallbacks']),('Gap-only fallbacks',lambda b:b['entry_proof_fallback_causes'].get('interval_gaps_only',0))]
 for name,fn in selectors:text+='| '+name+' | '+' | '.join(f'{fn(data[n]):,}'for n in [64,512,0])+' |\n'
 for cap in [64,0]:

text+='\nRequested byte coverage is not physical memory traffic. All raw exits, proof causes, mapping/guard results and compile counters are retained. Removing a compiled boundary does not remove guest instructions or change guest scheduling.\n'

p.write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2)+'\n');p=d/'CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_LIMITS_RESULTS.md';p.write_text(p.read_text().split('\n## Conditional-only runner-limit census')[0]+text);print(text)
